nominee.longerDescription: I might have never mentioned it, but I cannot keep it a secret anymore. I might be bi. When I look at Antonio at least, I feel something I usually only feel towards women. It's especially difficult becuase it cannot really be aligned with my religious beliefs. But I can't do anything about it, this is just who I am. You're the first person I'm telling this, because I fully trust you. I wouldn't expect you to show this to anyone without my permission.
